name: StandardizeColumnNamesNode
label: Standardize Column Names
description: Renames all (or selected) columns to a consistent format. Options include snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, or Title Case, with optional removal of special characters and duplicate suffixes.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table whose columns to rename.

fields.name: CaseStyle
fields.label: Case Style
fields.description: The target case style: 'snake', 'camel', 'pascal', or 'title'. Defaults to 'snake'.

selectOptions.label: camelCase
selectOptions.description: lowercase first word, capitalized subsequent words.

selectOptions.label: PascalCase
selectOptions.description: every word capitalized with no separators.

fields.name: ColumnsToRename
fields.label: Columns To Rename
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to rename. Leave empty to rename all columns.

fields.name: EnsureUniqueNames
fields.label: Ensure Unique Names
fields.description: True to ensure all resulting column names are unique by appending suffixes. Defaults to true.

fields.name: ResultDataTable
fields.label: Result Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with standardized column names.
